scope: The FileInfo TOPP wrapper, its executable and the stage-1 preview workflows. The report branches are A4's library (tests/data/file_info_provenance.json); the lifecycle is CLI-1 and CLI-2's (tests/data/topp_cli_lifecycle_provenance.json). Sources come from the OpenMS4-topp, OpenMS4-cli and OpenMS4-test-data packages, which are versioned independently of the Core SDK and are deliberately not resolved against it.

upstream_test_definition.comparison: FuzzyDiff with the pinned FuzzyDiff.ini (ratio 1.01, absdiff 0.01) and -whitelist "File name", through tests/support/fuzzy_string_comparator.rs

method: Each case runs the tool through openms::cli::run_with in its own TempDir, with the registered or oracle arguments, and compares the exit code, the captured streams and the produced files. Reports are compared byte for byte after normalising the 'File name: ' text line and the 'general: file name' TSV line, which embed the input path; the four registered comparisons additionally run the retained expectation through FuzzyDiff as registered. Usage text is compared after removing the C++ console-width probe line ('stty: stdin isn't a terminal') and replacing the build revision. One case runs the built executable as a process.
evidence: Tier 1: retained upstream outputs of TOPP_FileInfo_1, _2, _3 and _9 through FuzzyDiff, and the product-SDK FileInfo (Debug, core 4fdec46; decision D7) from the C1 oracle (../oracle/topp-early-bundle run1, 21 FileInfo cases) and this package's oracle (../oracle/topp-file-info-tool, 17 cases, run twice with identical exit codes, normalised streams and outputs). Tier 4: the explicit refusals of the unported branches and flags, the executable's process behaviour, and the strict library default behind the tool's source-compatible mzML reading. No case reaches a Debug-only precondition of the oracle build.
shared_files_touched: src/format/file_info/model.rs: the native Options::source_dangling_references field, default false

external_reference_note: No C++ and no oracle driver is committed to this repository. The two oracle directories live next to it under ../oracle/; their driver files and manifests are recorded here by sha256, and every fixture they produced is hashed in fixtures.
native_differences: Unported branches and flags exit 11 with an explicit message where C++ reports them and exits 0 (decisions D3 and D5(c)).
TOPP_FileInfo_9 runs on the derived input; three mzML reader gaps outside this package refuse the registered one.
A forced type the file contradicts exits 6 (peak branch) or 11 (featureXML branch) where C++ exits 3 and 8.
Options are validated before the tool body, so a missing or empty -in leaves no -out file, where C++ leaves an empty one; the exit codes agree.
The source-compatible mzML reading writes one warning per dangling ID to the crate's warning log stream, where the C++ reader is silent.
The usage text carries no console-width probe line and names this crate's core revision; the run timing line is not ported.
determinism: serial, as the source; -threads is accepted and changes no byte (threads_do_not_change_the_reports).
